principles: A depth can be partitioned into persistent tiles.
Guild presence is accumulated through player actions, not a single toggle.
Guild objectives are shared projects with visible progress.
Completed structures alter the persistent world.
Defended structures can remain indefinitely while defence conditions are maintained.
Destruction changes state rather than erasing history.
Destroyed structures return a configured fraction of stored components as salvage.
Every state change is represented by an authoritative event.
Client presentation never decides ownership, completion, destruction, or salvage.
macro_loop: attackers can damage or destroy it
mvp_rule: The Shallows remains the playable proof. Guild world objectives are persistence architecture for later depths and must not block the first walkable social release.
